blessingofpandora.love_hud.intro.love: Wear in a Pandora charm slot to share supported charm effects with your maids in loaded chunks. Keep the seven promises to evolve this orb.
blessingofpandora.love_hud.intro.eternal: Wear in a Pandora charm slot to keep Love's shared gifts and grant seven powers to you and your bound maid alone. Turn to Seven promises to view your progress.
blessingofpandora.love_hud.obtain.title: The first contract · Obtaining Love
blessingofpandora.love_hud.obtain.body:
Tame your very first maid while wearing a Pandora Necklace to receive Love, once per player. A first contract made without the necklace, an earlier contract or a transfer of ownership grants no reward.
Love is forever bound to that first maid. Fulfil seven promises to evolve it into Eternal Devotion · Never Forgotten. The bond endures, and the orb grants seven powers while equipped, including its original charm sharing.
blessingofpandora.love_hud.private: This bond belongs to another. Neither your progress nor theirs is revealed on these pages.
blessingofpandora.love_hud.unbound: This orb has no recorded bond with you. Its rules can be read, but no personal progress is shown. Creative copies cannot create a first-maid bond or progress towards evolution.
blessingofpandora.love_hud.condition.1.b: Wear Love in a Pandora charm slot for a total of 24 hours of play. Time follows game ticks; it does not advance while you are offline or Love is unequipped.
blessingofpandora.love_hud.condition.2.b: Your bound maid must never truly die. A recorded death is permanent: resurrection, relogging and resetting progress cannot erase it.
blessingofpandora.love_hud.condition.3.b: While you wear Love, your bound maid must deal at least 1,314,520 points of actual health damage in total. Damage from other maids, absorbed damage and overkill do not count.
blessingofpandora.love_hud.condition.4.b: While wearing Love, defeat your bound maid once each at Gomoku, Chinese chess and chess. Further victories at one game cannot stand in for the others.
blessingofpandora.love_hud.condition.5.b: While wearing Love, spend a total of more than 30 minutes of play with your bound maid, both in Flower Forest and in the same dimension.
blessingofpandora.love_hud.condition.6.b: Once Love has been worn, a new contract with another maid erases all accumulated progress and returns the evolved orb to Love. The first bond and every recorded death remain.
blessingofpandora.love_hud.condition.7.b: While wearing Love, send one chat message containing both 女仆 and 我爱你, with no forbidden words. A forbidden word breaks the vow even if 我爱你 is also present.

blessingofpandora.love_hud.safety.title: Shared gifts and their limits
blessingofpandora.love_hud.eternal_limit:
When the orb's power ends, every chunk it kept loaded is released, including the maid's current chunk and those recently left behind.
After Immortality saves a life, it rests for 3 seconds (60 game ticks). You and your bound maid have separate cooldowns and can still take damage during them; no invulnerability is granted.
Your maid will not be pulled into flight while sitting, sleeping, riding, carrying a passenger or leashed. These orders and states are left undisturbed.
blessingofpandora.love_hud.safety.body:
Only charms in worn Pandora charm slots are shared, including those inside equipped necklaces and bracelets. Sharing neither copies items nor gives your maid extra slots. Items in your inventory, cosmetic slots and other equipment are not shared.
These effects cannot be shared: player hunger, extra slots, curse reversal, XP absorption, menus, client-side auto-attacks, player-only mod powers and unverified effects from other mods. Reality index, mana resistance and supported combat effects can be shared.
You must be online and alive for your maids to share these gifts. Love does not keep chunks loaded; its evolved form does so only for the bound maid.
blessingofpandora.love_hud.penalty.title: Binding promises · Choose your words
blessingofpandora.love_hud.penalty.body:
From the first time Love is worn, jealousy and the vow's penalties remain in force. Unequipping, relogging or evolving the orb cannot escape them. Taming another maid resets all accumulated progress and returns the evolved orb to Love.
A chat message containing 女仆 together with any forbidden word permanently destroys both forms of the orb. They can never be obtained again, including through Creative Mode; carried or dropped copies are also destroyed.
Forbidden words: 不, 讨厌, 恨, 厌恶, 憎恶, 嫌弃, 恶心, 去死, 滚, 讨嫌, 烦人, 垃圾, 贱.
Only the words themselves count: spaces and invisible formatting are ignored, regardless of what you meant. Even 女仆，我不会离开你 destroys the orb because it contains 不. Saying 我爱你 in the same message does not protect the vow.
item.blessingofpandora.love.evolve_obtai: Fulfil the seven promises with your permanently bound maid. Retains charm sharing and grants seven equipped abilities.
item.blessingofpandora.eternal_love.scop: New abilities affect only you and your permanently bound maid. Existing charm sharing keeps its original scope.
item.blessingofpandora.eternal_love.effe: I · Love: your maids retain Love's supported charm-sharing effects.

II · Immortality: restore full health instead of dying to lethal damage.
   You and your bound maid each have a separate 3-second cooldown (60 game ticks).
III · No Regrets: your attacks have no effect on your bound maid and provoke no response to being attacked.
IV · This Life: grants creative flight to you both. While you fly, your bound maid follows within 8 blocks.

V · Unforgotten: keeps your bound maid's current chunk loaded.
   Chunks she leaves stay loaded for 30 seconds by default (600 game ticks).
VI · A Lifetime: grants you both +1314% damage (original damage ×14.14).

VII · Love: both have exactly 520 armor.
   Equipment is unchanged; original armor values return when the orb is unequipped.

item.blessingofpandora.love.warning:
After first wearing Love, 女仆 with banned words such as 不, 讨厌 or 恨 permanently destroys both orb forms.
Matching is literal: even a positive sentence containing 不 triggers destruction. Unequipping, relogging and evolution grant no exemption.
item.blessingofpandora.love.conditions: Eternity: 24 hours of equipped play time. Endurance: no actual death of the bound maid. Battle: 1,314,520 health damage dealt by that maid while equipped. Wisdom: beat her once at each of Gomoku, Xiangqi and Chess while equipped. Romance: spend over 30 minutes together in Flower Forest while equipped. Jealousy: taming another maid after first wearing Love resets progress and downgrades the evolved orb. Vow: while equipped, chat must contain 女仆 and 我爱你. Banned negative words take precedence and cause a permanent ban on both orb forms. Live progress appears in the item tooltip.

enchantment.blessingofpandora.pandora_cu: Obtaining: Like vanilla curses, this enchantment can appear on equipment in loot chests. Place the equipment and a regular book in the two grindstone input slots. Taking the enchanted book removes all enchantments from the equipment and transfers Pandora's Curse to the book; the equipment remains in its original slot.
